description: ED v61: retrain the v58 three-plane CNN on ES main-track clusters from sn-burst-samples cats at production conditions (tick3_ch2_min2_tot3_e3p0), cat-level split identical to CT v80 (train 400-571, val 572-596, test 597-621). Raw ADC input, angular loss with a numerically safe acos clip, clipnorm, NaN guard, best checkpoint by val_loss. Baseline v58 evaluated on the same test clusters.

data.selection: pipeline three-plane: main-track (col2==1) match_id (col13!=-1) present in X,U,V; X metadata as reference
data.preprocessing: raw float32 ADC, channel dim appended, no normalization (as v58 / pipeline ed_inference.py)
